Registry transaction-log fixtures in this directory are copied from the regipy
project test corpus:

https://github.com/mkorman90/regipy/tree/master/regipy_tests/data

Source files:

- transactions_NTUSER.DAT.xz
- transactions_ntuser.dat.log1.xz
- transactions_ntuser.dat.log2.xz

regipy is distributed under the MIT license. These fixtures are used only by
tests that verify real transaction-log replay behavior through the optional
regipy runtime adapter.
